answer: Physical space-time witness ledger. Each agent identity must anchor to a distinct physical site whose tamper-evident sensor vault logs local entropy; the ledger only admits an identity if its site’s entropy stream matches no other within a set time window. A single operator cannot occupy two sites at once, so duplicating an identity requires renting, powering, and maintaining separate physical locations. Sites echo their signed readings through independent relays, and a lotus-shaped antenna array binds each reading to its coordinates.
